verdict.rationale: Box can be driven fully headlessly through its REST API with OAuth access tokens, including a documented curl call using a developer token. A Box CLI is mentioned for giving agents access, and a Box folder can be mounted into an agent runtime as a POSIX filesystem, so scripted and agent automation outside the UI is clearly supported. missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline guidance, documented non-interactive server-to-server auth (developer tokens suit testing, not unattended CI), in-depth Box CLI documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
